data.exact_reserve_text: Estimate of gross incurred claims (table title on page 14)
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross claims reserve release of GBP 1.249 million for prior underwriting years, primarily driven by favorable claims development as indicated by loss ratios remaining below forecast. This figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013. The report also notes that the 2013 underwriting year closed with a net profit of GBP 1.107 million, which includes expenses and investment return, further indicating a positive run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss ratios on all Years of Account remain below those allowed for in the Syndicate Business Forecasts.
assumptions and experience relating to mortality and morbidity
If a lower mortality rate were assumed to apply, the long term business provision would decrease.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development percentage could not be reliably calculated due to inconsistencies between the balance sheet's 'Claims outstanding' and the 'Estimate of gross incurred claims' in the claims development triangle.
